messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1070] Rscrpit error
parts:
So is this a distinct issue form #1060 or are you trying to get twice as much support by using two separate threads? Unfortunately, the law of inverse support is true: the more issues you open, the less support you get, because you are just confusing the support person. So let's say we bring #1060 to a resolution, then we come back to this one, if it still exists.

Antonio
